natalie: Quick async — pulling together final owners for the INC-834 postmortem action list. Can people confirm what they'll pick up and realistic due dates? Posting the current draft below for quick edits. :eyes:

natalie: ```
1) fix memory leak in router (root cause: windowed cache) - owner: ? - due: 2026-03-24
2) add canary routing for fallback path - owner: ? - due: 2026-03-30
3) update runbook + rollback steps (incl. playbook snippets) - owner: ? - due: 2026-04-02
4) GC tuning for storage shards - owner: ? - due: 2026-03-28
5) reserve infra capacity & pre-warm for next peak - owner: ? - due: 2026-04-06
```

ajay: I can take item 1. Will open a small PR for the cache guard + unit test. Targeting 3/24, but if I hit odd perf issues might need +2 days. :thumbsup:

leah: I'll own 3 (runbook). Will draft the playbook and run a tabletop with oncall next Tue. Due 2026-04-02 works.

ben: I'll pick up 5 but need a heads-up on exact peak window. @natalie can you confirm expected peak dates so I can scope reservation size? Also I need budget signoff; tentatively 4/06. :calendar:

sam: I'll help with 2 (canary routing) but need a short pairing session with infra (cc @ben). I can implement the routing flag and rollout policy; will need a canary window in staging for 48h. Propose due 2026-03-31 to leave one extra day for verification.

leah: For 4 (GC tuning) I can do the initial config proposal but want infra to run perf job. Suggest split: 4a config proposal by 3/28 (me), 4b perf run and validation by 4/02 (ben).

ben: Ack on split for 4. I'll schedule perf run and share results. If perf looks good we can push change to canary lane same week.

ajay: small note — the memory leak patch touches router cache TTL; I want a short canary too. Sam, can we align canary windows so both 1 and 2 have overlapping staging slots?

sam: Yes, I'll coordinate windows with infra. I'll post proposed windows by EOD tomorrow.

natalie: thanks all. Quick owner snapshot so it's easy to track: 1) ajay — due 2026-03-24 (may +2d) ; 2) sam — due 2026-03-31 ; 3) leah — due 2026-04-02 ; 4a) leah proposal — due 2026-03-28 ; 4b) ben perf/validation — due 2026-04-02 ; 5) ben infra reservation — due 2026-04-06.

natalie: Action items in the doc updated — please add PR links and comment "handed-off" when done. I'll run a sync on Friday during async check to close any gaps. :spiral_notepad:
